purpose: PRE-REGISTERED selection rule for a replacement comparator meta (Mahmood 6 Oct: 'solve it through comparator swaps'). Committed BEFORE any candidate search; candidates are judged per criterion from their own text, and the pick follows from R0, the criteria and the tie-breaks alone. How our pool compares with any candidate is NOT an input.

protocol_reference.question: In adults with primary insomnia, does melatonin reduce sleep-onset latency versus placebo? (Randomized placebo-controlled trials; mean difference in minutes.)
protocol_reference.eligibility: Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs in adults with primary insomnia or insomnia symptoms where melatonin is compared with placebo. Eligibility is on P/I/C/design only; outcome reporting is extraction status.
protocol_reference.analysis_population: pre-specified age 65-80 ITT subgroup (of an 18-80 enrolment)

R0_current_comparator.test: the current comparator is assessed against C1-C6 by the same procedure as every candidate. It is RETIRED only if it fails at least one criterion (reason = that criterion, span = its evidence); if it passes all six it is KEPT and the topic is NO_SWAP (the block is acquisition, not the comparator).

criteria.pass_if: the meta's full text is held under CC BY or CC0 (Europe PMC licence field, else the Unpaywall location licence); any other licence, or free-to-read without a licence, fails (lane licence rule)
the analysis pools randomised controlled trials only (its own eligibility / methods statement)

the pooled analysis is in the protocol's population: In adults with primary insomnia, does melatonin reduce sleep-onset latency versus placebo? (Randomized placebo-controlled trials; mean difference in minutes.) (eligibility: Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs in adults with primary insomnia or insomnia symptoms where melatonin is compared with placebo. Eligibility is on P/I/C/design only; outcome reporting is extraction status.)
the pooled comparison is melatonin / prolonged-release melatonin / controlled-release melatonin / Circadin versus placebo / control
it pools Sleep-onset latency (protocol timepoint: end of treatment) on the estimand family MD (a standardised difference fails)
it prints per-trial rows for that outcome (a table, or a forest plot with counts or effects, in the article or its own open supplement) AND a pooled result for it

tie_breaks.score: 1 = MD on the protocol's scale; 0 = other
number of trials in the pooled analysis of the protocol outcome

if_none_pass: NO_ACHIEVABLE_COMPARATOR: record the closest candidate and its single failing criterion; the topic keeps its current comparator; no criterion is relaxed after the search
selector: scripts/g1_comparator_select.py (deterministic; reads this rule and the typed candidates file)
process: scripts/g1_swap.py (rules -> search -> screen -> select); enumeration and acquisition follow the pick
